description: Windenergieanlagen Landkreis Nordwestmecklenburg (WMS) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoport-nwm.de. The wind turbine service is the model for punctual geometries that have basic attributes that clearly identify them as wind turbines from the point of view of the eE-Services project. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Wind turbines Landkreis Nordwestmecklenburg (WMS)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspireidentifiziert. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2026-03-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
